meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后,你可以在 Emacs 里直接和 Claude 对话。它会打开一个聊天缓冲区,回复会以 org 格式显示;你选中的 org 内容(如笔记、待办)发送后,回复会作为子标题插在原处。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中按快捷键打开聊天窗口并发送消息,或对选中的 org 段落执行发送命令时,Claude 会收到内容并在原地返回回复。

howto.what_en: After installing, you can talk to Claude directly from Emacs. It opens a chat buffer and replies render as org-mode; when you send selected org content like notes or agenda items, the reply appears as a child heading inline.
howto.when_en: When you open the chat buffer in Emacs with its keybinding and send a message, or run the org-send command on a selected org region, Claude receives it and replies in place.
